s1.syndrome_frame: intermittent painless hematuria with clot passage in an elderly patient with underlying medical conditions
salient_findings: exophytic solid tumor on the bladder wall
adenocarcinoma with mucinous and signet-ring cell components on histopathology
key_facts: denies dysuria, frequency, or other lower urinary tract symptoms
unremarkable vital signs and abdominal and pelvic exams
normal serum creatinine and biochemical parameters
transabdominal ultrasonography showed a 2.9 × 2.5 × 2.4 cm polypoidal mass in the bladder
cystoscopy demonstrated an exophytic solid tumor on the anterior fundal wall
histopathological analysis revealed adenocarcinoma with mucinous and signet-ring cell components
